notes.title: Version 1.1.0 ✨
notes.notes:
The difficulty of the "Hand" mini-game has been reduced.
 The Easy difficulty level has been replaced with a "Classic" mode (opponent disabled).
 Added a cheat (F key), available only in "Classic" mode, without being recorded in the leaderboards.
 Minor fixes.
